_comment: PII linter hook for Google Gemini CLI.
after_tool: after Gemini writes/edits a file, scan it. The agent
sets $GEMINI_TOOL_FILE_PATH for the hook. Exit 2 on HIGH+.
Stop:       at end-of-turn, scan the staged diff. Exit 2 to force
cleanup before the agent finishes the turn.

hooks.command: bash -c 'f="$GEMINI_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.csv|*.jsonl|*.md) pii-lint scan -- "$f" || exit 2;; esac'
